collection.description: A visitor asks a gardener for a cutting of a Mela Rare Oak, known in Isolan lore as the Fruit of Life.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A gardener tends a Mela Rare Oak, remembered in Isolan lore as the Fruit of Life. A visitor asks for a rare cutting to test its reputed gift.

choices.label: Share only a viable propagated cutting
Observe and record over a season
Offer a blessing instead of material

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A new plant may establish elsewhere, but the parent must recover and the claimed gift remains uncertain.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The gardener protects a scarce specimen, disappointing the visitor but preserving future options.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The visitor accepts a meaningful gesture; no one claims it replaces practical study.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: The gardener logs growth, fragrance, fruiting or visitors; ordinary patterns coexist with unusual anecdotes.
